suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects JetBrains Kotlin build-cache metadata deserialization on all versions before 2.4.20. As of this writing, JetBrains has only published Beta releases of 2.4.20 (2.4.20-Beta1/Beta2) on Maven Central - no stable fixed release exists yet. This project is already pinned to the latest available stable Kotlin release (see the `kotlin` version in gradle/libs.versions.toml). Re-evaluate and remove this suppression once a stable 2.4.20+ Kotlin release is available.

CVE-2020-29582 is present on old org.jetbrains.kotlin artifacts (kotlin-reflect 1.6.10/2.0.21, kotlin-stdlib 2.0.21, kotlin-stdlib-jdk7/jdk8 1.8.0, kotlin-compiler- embeddable 2.0.21, kotlin-daemon-embeddable 2.0.21, kotlin-script-runtime 2.0.21) that are pulled in transitively by this project's `detekt` Gradle configuration - detekt 1.23.8's own bundled/embedded Kotlin compiler, resolved via a `strictly` version constraint. These jars are build-tool-only and are never shipped in the application artifact. detekt 1.23.8 is the latest release on Maven Central; there is no newer version available to pick up an updated embedded compiler. Re-evaluate and remove this suppression once detekt ships a release with an updated bundled Kotlin compiler.

CVE-2026-91776 (unbounded type id cache growth in TypeDeserializer) and CVE-2026-91777 (quadratic forward-reference resolution in Collection/Map deserializers) affect jackson-databind 2.22.2. The fixes (FasterXML/jackson-databind#6203, #6204) were merged in September 2026 but no patched release is on Maven Central yet - 2.22.2 is the latest available version (see the `jackson-bom` version in gradle/libs.versions.toml). Re-evaluate once a fixed jackson-bom is released, bump it and remove this suppression. The `until` date makes the check fail again if this is forgotten.
